title: DPP-3: Normalization and Bidi Forgery Battery — Byte-Exact Match Path with a Frozen Regression Tripwire (All 6 Falsifiers Pass)
description:
Normalization and bidi-forgery battery against the guarded ingestion path. All 50/50 visual-twin records (NFKC-normalized and bidi-reordered lookalikes) were rejected by the byte-exact match path; a no-normalization probe confirmed the gate does not depend on normalization being applied; a unicode-nullity control run confirmed unicode content contributes nothing to any verdict. Caveat disclosed: human-eye indistinguishability is not a claim — the battery gates on bytes, not on visual appearance. A frozen regression tripwire preserves the result for nightly re-runs.
